item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00407","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C05","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.83,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C10 provides the strongest reusable template: a reply to a foreign head of government that acknowledges his communication describing an urgent domestic problem, affirms American concern, and announces that the President has instructed a U.S. diplomatic representative to take concrete steps to provide assistance. The child follows substantially the same diplomatic and administrative sequence, adapted from emergency food relief in East Germany to aid programs in Iran. C05 also combines reassurance to an allied leader with a commitment of economic assistance, but its armistice-centered argument and lengthy numbered program are less structurally similar. C23 is another supportive response to a foreign leader's humanitarian appeal, but it lacks the child's distinctive machinery of authorizing a diplomatic representative to consult with the recipient.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I have received your letter of August 26 regarding the problems which you face in Iran.","parent_excerpt":"The receipt of your [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], in which you outlined the serious situation existing in the Soviet Zone of Germany concerning the supply of food for the population","explanation":"Both open by acknowledging a foreign leader's communication describing a serious internal problem requiring assistance."},{"child_excerpt":"In an effort to assist you in dealing with your immediate problems, I have authorized my Ambassador to Iran to consult with you regarding the development of our aid programs there.","parent_excerpt":"I have, therefore, today instructed the American Charge d'Affaires in Moscow to offer the Soviet Government shipments of food for distribution to the population of East Germany.","explanation":"Both translate the response into immediate presidential instructions to a U.S. diplomatic representative concerning concrete aid."},{"child_excerpt":"Your request will receive our sympathetic consideration and I can assure you that we stand ready to assist you","parent_excerpt":"I am, therefore, anxious to respond affirmatively to your appeal that this Government join you in aiding the people of East Germany","explanation":"Both give a favorable, reassuring response to the foreign leader's request for American assistance."}]}
